lead_independence.headline: Man shot dead at Fort Pierce mobile home park after attacking homeowner, no charges filed
lead_independence.lead: A 37-year-old man was shot and killed after deputies say he entered a St. Lucie County home and attacked a 22-year-old man during a dispute.
